approval_scope: Design and offline model review only. No production source, evaluator implementation, installation, capacity recovery, financial result or natural review is approved.
design_assessment: Written safety boundaries and explicit accounting-policy change are credible as a conditional research proposal. The symbolic model has a reproducible domain-eligibility defect and must be corrected before accepting the frozen design evidence.

findings.title: Symbolic ledger grants reduced-cost hits in the economic domain
findings.reproduction: Candidate unchanged ledger([("ECONOMIC:A",50),("ECONOMIC:A",50)],75,2) returns charge 51 and admitted true. Design requires economic verification to remain independently fully charged: charge 100 and admission false.
findings.impact: The one-economic-item example passes without testing repeated economic identities; the reusable model permits behavior explicitly prohibited by the design. This is a model defect, not a production evaluator bypass.
findings.required_change: Freeze a new candidate preserving v1. Restrict reusable insertion/hits to the explicitly eligible PUBLIC domain; repeated ECONOMIC and RAW_PARSE entries must retain required full charges, never gain economic/public authorization or evict PUBLIC proofs. Add mixed-domain repeated-key adversarial cases and regenerate the symbolic receipt.

disclosed_research_gates_not_additional_: Exact positive hit/miss/failed-work/live-memory accounting formulas remain unfrozen. Equal numeric caps do not establish equal policy after reduced logical-work charges.
Old 34e0 logical transcript/shadow-meter equivalence for differing incoming cache/context states remains unproved. Neither cost totals alone nor a cached final result proves all intermediate guards.
Conservative complete-identity keys have no demonstrated useful real hits; 141 symbolic units are not a prediction about the 130760540-byte workload.

old_history_bottleneck_assessment.unchanged_current_accounting: 130760540 remains above 128000000, so ordinary caching that retains all charges cannot admit the failed batch.
old_history_bottleneck_assessment.historical_reconstruction: Completed historical September 29 context is 114633672, below the old cap; this alone does not make old-history validation an inevitable blocker to every new-version root. Any required historical reconstruction that actually rejects under its own unchanged old meter remains an absolute rejection: no certificate, new meter or cache may waive it.
old_history_bottleneck_assessment.reuse_feasibility: Whole public bundles were already reconstructed once by the existing shared verified set. A whole-bundle proof cache alone has no evidenced redundant completed work to remove. The recurring predecessor/economic work is deliberately outside discounted authorization. Any benefit requires demonstrated repeated PUBLIC substatements with identical complete keys, not deletion of the 114633672 child aggregate.
old_history_bottleneck_assessment.claim: Feasibility remains UNKNOWN; capacity_fixed=false. No financial or natural gate is upgraded.

next_minimal_falsifiable_step.scope: Separate frozen offline trace/key and shadow-ledger experiment; no evaluator replacement or business execution. First repair the model counterexample.
next_minimal_falsifiable_step.inputs: Reuse existing approved aggregate diagnosis. If event identities are absent, specify a separately reviewed read-only instrumentation capture on an isolated historical copy; do not infer complete keys from aggregate counters or rerun a native batch.
next_minimal_falsifiable_step.test: Select one repeated candidate PUBLIC verification statement, freeze its exact dependency/incoming-state key and positive hit/materialization/live-memory formula, then independently compare cold and shadow intermediate guard decisions against the exact old implementation across below/at/above and incoming-state variations. Record zero hits honestly.
stop_rules: If only repeated economic work or distinct historical-key statements exist, reject that cache scope as a capacity remedy; do not weaken keys.
If old-method shadow checks reject or cannot be shown equivalent at every relevant boundary, the historical proof is ineligible regardless of new global budget.
Quantify potential savings net of all required hit/recheck/memory charges; the diagnosed 2760540 excess is a necessary baseline hurdle, not a future admission guarantee.
Do not authorize production implementation until all three disclosed gates have independently reviewed evidence. Preserve formulas, numeric limits, original chains and incomplete September 30 batch.
